tailoring.headline: Senior E-Commerce Specialist | SAP Commerce Cloud, Java & Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years delivering large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, micro-services and OCC REST APIs, I design and implement end-to-end product catalog, pricing and order management solutions. Proven track record in PIM/ERP/MDM data integration, API migrations and performance tuning. Skilled in techno-functional analysis, stakeholder workshops, user story creation and agile delivery, leveraging AI tools for rapid development.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Product Manager (E-Commerce)
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Choco’s mission to transform food commerce with data-driven, sustainable solutions. The Senior Product Manager role aligns perfectly with my 5+ years of building high-performing SAP Commerce Cloud platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, where I delivered end-to-end e-commerce experiences and drove integration strategies.

bullets.label: E-Commerce Platform Expertise
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and implemented SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) solutions covering product catalog, pricing and order management, directly supporting global B2B/B2C sales.

bullets.label: API & Integration Leadership
bullets.text: I built OCC REST APIs and orchestrated PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders, ensuring seamless integration with SAP ERP and MDM systems.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Business Analysis
bullets.text: Working in a techno-functional role, I gathered requirements, wrote user stories and functional specs, and collaborated with international stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & Stakeholder Management
bullets.text: I led agile squads, performed code reviews, managed CI/CD deployments on CCv2 and mentored junior developers, consistently delivering releases on schedule.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Choco’s growth.

tailoring.why_company: Choco’s vision of reshaping food commerce through a data-centric, sustainable marketplace resonates with my passion for building technology that connects producers and consumers efficiently. Your focus on AI-driven personalization and transparent supply chains matches my experience delivering AI-assisted, integrated e-commerce solutions at scale. I am eager to apply my SAP Commerce expertise and stakeholder-focused approach to help Choco accelerate growth and delight customers across Europe.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join Choco to combine my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise with your AI-driven, sustainable food commerce platform, driving innovative e-commerce experiences for millions of users.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of e-commerce experience. I’m excited about Choco’s mission and would love to discuss how I can help shape your product roadmap. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Senior Product Manager (E-Commerce) – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Product Manager (E-Commerce) position at Choco. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience delivering end-to-end e-commerce solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to bring my techno-functional expertise and agile delivery skills to your team. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit.
